title: Consent Protocol
tagline: Decentralised consensual data and ad sharing protocol, allow ads to be served in your browser using data aggregated on you over different browing history, you can select what data can be shared and you determine who can purchase said data
description:
Users allow the Dapp to store browsing history across web pages and store this data across all their sessions. This data can include browsing history, transaction history, clicks, navigations etc.

The data accumulated is shown to users at the end of an epoch e.g monthly, weekly, daily and uses can pick which data they want to share, the more they share, the more reward they can get
The data is then aggregated (combination of user data across applications), hashed and put on sale in form of a minted NFT in the data marketplace.

The protocol can aggregate said data from consenting users, analyze and deduce information from it and then market it to buyers

There will be a DAO that users can participate in by sharing more, users get governance tokens when they share and can therefore propose and vote on the DAO
how_its_made:
The project uses metamask wallet to connect behind the scene. 
We used @scaffold-eth for the frontend, figma for the design, @Lit protocol for storing the data on-chain, and @Spheron for hosting the app.

We plan to continue working on this project by adding a chat feature with @XMTP, @NFTport to detect counterfiet NFTs as well as build a mobile responsive web page for it.
